transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Any time I’m near where there might be snakes, I feel an immediate rush of fear that I can’t shake. It has become really overwhelming, and I realized I need some help to deal with it.
Do you actively go out of your way to avoid situations or places where you might encounter snakes, even if it interferes with your daily routine?

Yes, I constantly go out of my way to avoid them, like rerouting school field trips, delegating nature walks to other staff, and skipping my hiking club's outings. It has really started to interfere with both my job and my personal life, making me feel like I'm not fully doing my work or living the active life I used to enjoy.
